$comment: Identity of the DeepSeek Harness runtime this desktop build bundles. Written by scripts/bump-dsh-version.mjs and read by scripts/check-dsh-update.mjs plus docs/CI. The authoritative per-package pins live in package.json; this file records which of them is the tracked upstream runtime and on which channel it was taken, so workflows never have to guess.
note: DSH has no stable (non-prerelease) publication yet, so 0.1.5-rc.2 is itself a prerelease. It was selected by semver comparison across the latest and next dist-tags, not by trusting a single tag: `latest` currently points at 0.1.5-rc.1, which is OLDER than `next` = 0.1.5-rc.2.
